description: Returns every distinct code catalogued under a given code_type, paginated, with each code's raw chargemaster description and the number of hospitals reporting it. Use this to discover which codes exist under a code system (e.g. all CPT codes) before looking up prices with get_hospital_chargemaster_cost or list_hospital_code_costs.

code_type.description: Code system to list codes for, e.g. "CPT". From list_code_types.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 500, capped at 500.

page_token.description: Opaque token from a previous list_codes response. Omit for the first page.

sort.description: Ordering for the returned codes. CODE_SORT_UNSPECIFIED (default) sorts code-alphabetical. CODE_SORT_HOSPITAL_COUNT_DESC sorts most-hospitals-reporting first, for pre-sorted 'top codes' pages.

name: list_codes

hospital_count.description: Distinct hospitals reporting this code (latest revision only).

raw_description.description: Raw chargemaster text, picked across reporting hospitals. Not necessarily a human-readable procedure name.

next_page_token.description: Opaque pagination token, empty when there are no more results.

total_count.description: Total number of matching codes across all pages.

title: List billing codes for a code type
